race.comment: FROSTED AMBER (6) comes here fifth up and desperate for the firmer track. Struggled to run the 1400m out on the heavy (10) track when fifth over 1400m at Gundagai in a Super Maiden. Rates highly in this field and can turn things around. LULL US AWAY (7) leading contender at start sixteen after running on late to finish third over 1200m at Corowa. On the eight-day back-up and no excuses here from the rails draw. WESTERN LIGHTS (10) worked hard from the sticky gate and was a spent force in the straight when tiring to finish seventh over 1200m at Corowa. Earlier runs had merit and keep safe. TASSY FOX (9) resumes after showing ability when running some handy races last time in. Came to the end of her prep with a struggling eighth over 1400m at Gundagai. Back with one trial and can sprint well fresh.
